log(λi)=β0+β1(Ethnic Minority Percentagei)+Si

```{r}
library(CARBayes)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

lad_model <- lad_data %>%
  left_join(final, by = c("LAD24CD" = "area_code"))

lad_model <- lad_model %>%
  rename(
    stillbirths = stillbirths.x,
    births = births.x,
    ethnic_minority_pct = ethnic_minority_pct.x
  )

# Scale predictor
lad_model <- lad_model %>%
  mutate(
    ethnic_minority_pct_scaled = as.numeric(scale(ethnic_minority_pct))
  )

# England model data
england_sf <- lad_model %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ethnic_minority_pct_scaled),
    !is.na(stillbirths),
    !is.na(births),
    births > 0,
    str_detect(LAD24CD, "^E")
  )

england_sf <- england_sf[card(poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)) > 0, ]

england_data <- england_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

england_nb <- poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)

england_W <- listw2mat(nb2listw(england_nb, style = "B"))
england_W <- (england_W + t(england_W)) / 2
england_W <- ifelse(england_W > 0, 1, 0)

england_model_ethnicity <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = stillbirths ~
    ethnic_minority_pct_scaled +
    offset(log(births)),
  family = "poisson",
  data = england_data,
  W = england_W,
  burnin = 10000,
  n.sample = 50000
)

# Regression coefficients and confidence intervals
england_results <- england_model_ethnicity$summary.results %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    parameter = rownames(.),
    model = "England"
  )

beta_results <- england_results

# Spatial correlation parameter
spatial_results <- data.frame(
  model = "England",
  spatial_correlation = england_model_ethnicity$summary.results["rho", "Mean"]
)

# Unexplained spatial variance
england_variance <- data.frame(
  model = "England",
  unexplained_variance = var(as.vector(england_model_ethnicity$samples$phi))
)

variance_results <- england_variance

# Combine results
CARBayes_results <- list(
  regression_coefficients = beta_results,
  spatial_correlation = spatial_results,
  unexplained_variance = variance_results
)

write_xlsx(
  CARBayes_results,
  file.path(folder, "CARBayes_model_results_ethnicity_only.xlsx")
)

# Predicted stillbirth counts
england_data$predicted_stillbirths <- england_model_ethnicity$fitted.values

# Observed vs predicted plot
observed_predicted_plot <- ggplot(
  england_data,
  aes(x = predicted_stillbirths, y = stillbirths)
) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    colour = "red",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs Predicted Stillbirth Counts (Ethnicity + Spatial Effect)",
    x = "Predicted stillbirths",
    y = "Observed stillbirths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  file.path(folder, "observed_vs_predicted_ethnicity_only.png"),
  observed_predicted_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

observed_predicted_plot
```

```{r}
library(CARBayes)
library(spdep)
library(writexl)


n <- nrow(england_sf)

observed <- england_data$stillbirths
predicted <- numeric(n)


for(i in 1:n){


  # Remove left-out LAD

  train_sf <- england_sf[-i, ]
  train_data <- england_data[-i, ]


  # Neighbour matrix

  nb_train <- poly2nb(
    train_sf,
    queen = TRUE
  )


  # Remove isolated areas (same logic as working IMD model)

  keep <- card(nb_train) > 0

  train_sf <- train_sf[keep, ]
  train_data <- train_data[keep, ]


  # Recalculate neighbours

  nb_train <- poly2nb(
    train_sf,
    queen = TRUE
  )


  # Spatial weights

  W_train <- listw2mat(
    nb2listw(
      nb_train,
      style = "B",
      zero.policy = TRUE
    )
  )


  W_train <- (W_train + t(W_train)) / 2
  W_train <- ifelse(W_train > 0, 1, 0)



  # Fit ethnicity model

  model <- S.CARleroux(
    formula =
      stillbirths ~
      ethnic_minority_pct_scaled +
      offset(log(births)),
    family = "poisson",
    data = train_data,
    W = W_train,
    burnin = 10000,
    n.sample = 50000
  )


  # Extract beta coefficients

  beta <- model$samples$beta

  beta_mean <- apply(beta, 2, mean)



  # Predict excluded LAD

  eta <-
    beta_mean[1] +
    beta_mean[2] *
    england_data$ethnic_minority_pct_scaled[i] +
    log(england_data$births[i])


  predicted[i] <- exp(eta)

}



# Performance

rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (observed - predicted)^2
  )
)


bias <- mean(
  predicted - observed
)



results <- data.frame(
  LAD = england_data$LAD24CD,
  observed = observed,
  predicted = predicted,
  error = predicted - observed
)


print(rmse)
print(bias)



write_xlsx(
  list(
    predictions = results,
    validation = data.frame(
      RMSE = rmse,
      Bias = bias
    )
  ),
  file.path(
    folder,
    "LOOCV_ethnicity_model.xlsx"
  )
)
```
